state_text.camera_info: Top-down camera photo of a floor workspace. The robot arm base is at the bottom centre of the image. A light-grey square tray with raised walls lies on the floor. Small objects may lie on the floor or inside the tray.

t_single.instructions: In `camera`, exactly one single an object that `instruction` asks to put into the tray and that is still outside the tray. Box only that one object, not a group of objects.

t_left.instructions: In `camera`, an object that `instruction` asks to put into the tray and that is still outside the tray; if there are several, the one nearest to the left edge of the image.

t_top.instructions: In `camera`, an object that `instruction` asks to put into the tray and that is still outside the tray; if there are several, the one nearest to the top edge of the image.

t_bottom.instructions: In `camera`, an object that `instruction` asks to put into the tray and that is still outside the tray; if there are several, the one nearest to the bottom edge of the image.

remaining.instructions: In `camera`, is there still at least one object outside the tray that `instruction` asks to put into the tray?
